result.instructions:
TerraScale dashboard tools manage organizations, projects, members, databases, data, backups, credentials, authentication, billing, and settings.
Calls are stateless: pass organizationId and projectId to choose the scope, or omit them to use your current dashboard selection. Call get_context first to discover the IDs you can use.

scopes.description: Choose a non-empty subset of exactly documents:read, documents:write, databases:read, databases:write. Document scopes cover documents, collections, queries, SQL over the Hrana/libSQL and Postgres wire protocols, file storage, functions, and change feeds. Database scopes cover databases, backups/restores, indexes, imports, read-only HTTP SQL (run, check, explain), saved queries, usage, and metrics. Read scopes grant reads; write scopes grant changes. Some operations require both: function management needs documents:read and documents:write; writing imports also needs documents:write; selective recovery also needs the corresponding document scope. No aliases, wildcards, or unknown scopes are accepted.

databaseId.description: Restrict the credential to one database ID. Omit for every database in the project.

organizationId.description: Organization ID to act on. Defaults to the caller's current dashboard organization.

projectId.description: Project ID to act on. Defaults to the current project, or the organization's default project when organizationId is given.

organizationCapCents.description: Organization-wide monthly spend cap in US cents; 0 removes it. Omit to leave it unchanged.

paidExcess.description: Bill usage above the plan allowance instead of blocking it. Omit to leave it unchanged.

readLimit.description: Monthly read limit; 0 removes it. Omit to leave it unchanged.

writeLimit.description: Monthly write limit; 0 removes it. Omit to leave it unchanged.

replicationLimit.description: Monthly replication limit; 0 removes it. Omit to leave it unchanged.

id.description: Project or database ID in the organization.

capCents.description: Monthly spend cap in US cents; 0 removes the cap. Omit to leave it unchanged.

projectCaps.description: Per-project caps to set; unlisted projects keep theirs.

readLimit.description: Monthly read limit; 0 removes it. Omit to leave it unchanged.

replicationLimit.description: Monthly replication limit; 0 removes it. Omit to leave it unchanged.

id.description: Project or database ID in the organization.

capCents.description: Monthly spend cap in US cents; 0 removes the cap. Omit to leave it unchanged.

databaseCaps.description: Per-database caps to set; unlisted databases keep theirs.

tools.name: set_spending_controls

limit.description: The plan's limit; 0 when it publishes none.

percent.description: Used as a percentage of Limit, when both are known.

allowances.description: Reads, writes, and storage against the plan's limits.

allowanceError.description: Why this month's usage failed to load, when TerraBase answered with an error.

spendCapCents.description: The organization's monthly spend cap in US cents; 0 means none.

paidExcessEnabled.description: Whether usage above the plan allowance is billed instead of blocked.

projectEffectiveCapCents.description: The smallest of the organization and selected project caps in US cents; 0 means no limit.

spendCapCents.description: The project's own monthly spend cap in US cents; 0 means none.

effectiveCapCents.description: The smallest of the organization and project caps in US cents; 0 means no limit.

logicalBytes.description: Logical storage: the bytes of the project's live documents.

unavailable.description: TerraBase did not report one of its system databases, so LogicalBytes is incomplete.

sharePercent.description: The project's share of the organization's logical storage.

logicalBytes.description: Logical storage: the bytes of the database's live documents.

unavailable.description: TerraBase did not report this system database, so its counts are unknown.

sharePercent.description: The database's share of the listed databases' logical storage.

metered.description: Whether TerraBase meters this database; its reads and writes are 0 otherwise.

spendCapCents.description: The database's own monthly spend cap in US cents; 0 means none.

effectiveCapCents.description: The smallest of the organization, project, and database caps in US cents; 0 means no limit.

available.description: Whether TerraBase's metered reads and writes could be loaded.

logicalBytes.description: Logical storage of the selected scope.

storageMeasured.description: Whether LogicalBytes and document counts are known: TerraBase measured them, or the dashboard holds the documents.

series.description: Reads and writes per UTC hour (24h, 7d) or day (30d), oldest first.

canManage.description: Whether the caller may change spending controls.
